title: Outbox entry
description: A proposed Notion change written by an agent to .arima/outbox/; only the orchestrator applies it (spec §3.3, D-07). There is deliberately no delete operation.

schema_version.description: Optional; absent means 1 (written before the field existed). A larger number is refused by the reader (WP-195).

id.description: Unique outbox entry id; letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen only (it becomes a file name)

item_id.description: ARIMA ID of the target (required for update, append_content, retire)

properties.description: Property name -> value, using names from notion-map.json

base_values.description: Values of the properties this entry writes, as the agent saw them (a human edit since then wins, section 3.3); filled by enqueue from the mirror when absent

base_last_edited.description: Notion last_edited_time the agent saw; a newer human edit wins (§3.3)
